description: Whistle LoRA probe — exploratory side artifact, not Moth (D28)

step_1_environment.install: uv venv .venv-whistle --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python .venv-whistle/bin/python "cactus-needle[train]" soxr soundfile
step_1_environment.deviation_from_plan: the plan said `cactus-needle[jax]`; cactus-needle 3.2.10 has no `jax` extra. The training extra is named `train` (jax, jaxlib, flax, optax, safetensors, sentencepiece, whisper-normalizer, soxr).
step_1_environment.platform: darwin arm64 (macOS 27.0.1), Apple M5, 17.2 GB RAM
step_1_environment.note: jax-metal is not installed and jax 0.12.0.1 reports CPU only, so training runs on CPU (plan risk 1 confirmed).

step_2_data.reproducible: bit-identical across reruns; sha256 of the three JSONL files is in data/split.json (`sha256`)

step_3_base_weights.note: the .safetensors base is not cached yet and is downloaded on first finetune; it is 220.6 MB, not part of any shipped artifact
